rounds.ai_message: Chen, this is Daniel. We've got a problem. The carrier just rolled our booking from the Maersk Madison to the Maersk Montana, sailing five days later. The retailer's DC slot is locked. Help me out.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 陈,Daniel。麻烦了。船公司刚把我们的舱从 Maersk Madison 改到 Maersk Montana,晚了 5 天。零售商的 DC 档期锁死了,帮我搞定。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 理解紧急,先稳住情绪,再给可行方案
key_phrases: Let me put out feelers with other carriers
I will escalate with Maersk directly
rounds.common_mistakes: 客户说 'help me out',你别只说 'sorry'。要立刻出选项:加钱插舱 / 分批出 / 走空运补货。
rounds.tips_zh: 舱位被甩(cancel booking)是常见痛点,提前一周确认船公司舱单,别等到截关。
rounds.user_response_example: I hear you. Two immediate options: I'll escalate with Maersk to get you on a Maersk Edmonds that sails in two days — same string, just earlier — or we can split the order and air-freight the urgent 30 percent. Which is cheaper for you depends on the rush, but the Edmonds is my pick.

rounds.ai_message: The Edmonds is my pick too. Pull that string. But I need you to absorb the demurrage risk if the container doesn't get picked up within the free time.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 我也选 Edmonds。去谈。但你们要承担堆场免堆期过后的滞港费风险。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 评估风险、谈判分担比例
key_phrases: We can share the demurrage risk
rounds.common_mistakes: demurrage(滞港费,堆场)/ detention(滞箱费,船公司)别混。negotiate 时讲清楚对应哪一项。
rounds.tips_zh: 大客户谈分摊,小客户谈一口价。demurrage 通常 USD 75-150/天,心里有数。
rounds.user_response_example: Free time at LA port is seven days — that should be enough. If your DC pickup slips past day 8, let's split the demurrage 50/50. I'll put that in writing.

rounds.ai_message: Acceptable. Now, the Form A — the customs broker flagged that our last shipment's fiber composition declaration was inconsistent with the lab report. Can your team do a fiber composition check on this lot before issuance?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 行。还有 Form A — 报关行说我们上一票的纤维成分声明跟检测报告对不上。这票你们发货前能做个纤维成分核对吗?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认能配合并安排内部 QC 节点
key_phrases: We will run a SGS fiber composition test
Allow 3-5 business days for the lab
The lab report will match the C/O
rounds.common_mistakes: fiber composition(fiber content)申报错误在欧美海关是 high-risk 错报,Form A 错填会罚款。
rounds.tips_zh: C/O 上写 '100% Cotton',实验室报告也得是 100% cotton,任何偏差都改。
rounds.user_response_example: Absolutely. We will run a SGS fiber composition test on bulk production samples, 3-5 business days turnaround. The lab report will be issued before the C/O, and the C/O will match the lab numbers exactly.

rounds.ai_message: Good. Now, will the actual C/O go through the China Council for the Promotion of International Trade? I need the issuing body on file for our import compliance team.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好。产地证是走中国贸促会出的吗?我合规团队要把出证机构记在档。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认出证机构并解释其权威性
key_phrases: We can also do electronic C/O
rounds.common_mistakes: C/O 出证机构:中国贸促会(CCPIT)vs 国家质检总局(现在并入海关)。两套系统,客户要哪种提前问。
rounds.tips_zh: 很多国家海关只认贸促会或海关出的 C/O,自家开的证不算。
rounds.user_response_example: Yes, all C/Os are issued by the China Council for the Promotion of International Trade (CCPIT) and notarized by the Zhejiang sub-council. We can also issue an e-C/O if your country supports it.

rounds.ai_message: Perfect. Last item: I need a commercial invoice and packing list in the buyer's format — not your template. I'll email the template tonight. Can you turn it around by tomorrow noon?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 完美。最后,发票和装箱单要按我客户模板,不是你们的版式。今晚我邮件发模板,明天中午前能出吗?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认能配合并预留时间
key_phrases: Please flag any fields we need to add
rounds.common_mistakes: 客户指定模板通常有额外字段:HS code、buyer's PO、country of origin、country of destination,要逐项确认。
rounds.tips_zh: 模板来了先 diff,缺什么字段提前说,别交了再改。
rounds.user_response_example: Yes, drop me the template and I'll have our shipping team populate it. By noon tomorrow you'll have the draft for review — please flag any fields that aren't on the template so we can add them on the first pass.
